请选择不含 Windows 键的组合键。: Choose a shortcut without the Windows key.
F12 保留用于紧急停止，请选择其他按键。: F12 is reserved for emergency stop. Choose another key.
请先结束输入法输入，再录入快捷键。: Finish IME composition before recording a shortcut.
请使用字母、数字、功能键或方向、导航等常用键。: Use a letter, number, function key, arrow or navigation key.
此组合已用于保存、搜索或应用配置，请选择其他组合。: This shortcut is reserved for saving, searching or applying profiles. Choose another.
此组合已由 Windows 使用，请选择其他快捷键。: Windows reserves this shortcut. Choose another.
玩家和世界坐标依靠加速度计估计重力方向。世界坐标的重力参考变化更缓慢。: Player and world space estimate gravity from the accelerometer. World space uses a slower gravity reference.
姿态归零重新记录当前朝向。设置正前方只重置水平朝向，保留重力方向上的俯仰与横滚。: Reset orientation records the current pose. Set forward resets only the heading, preserving pitch and roll relative to gravity.
按住指定按键后沿之前的方向继续转动；0 表示保持速度。松开后恢复手腕控制。: Hold the assigned button to continue the previous motion; 0 preserves the speed. Release it to regain wrist control.
实测噪声来自设备静止校准。噪声抑制宽度设为 0 时关闭这一层抑制。: Measured noise comes from stationary calibration. Set noise suppression width to 0 to disable this stage.
可修正倾斜漂移；加速度计无法观测绕重力方向的水平漂移。: Corrects tilt drift; the accelerometer cannot measure heading drift around gravity.
自动回中适用于本地坐标的水平轴；垂直轴使用姿态归零按键回中。玩家／世界坐标无法通: Automatic centering applies to the horizontal axis in local space. Use Reset orientation for vertical centering. Gravity cannot automatically restore heading in player or world space.
相对模式：逐渐返回拇指方向: Relative mode: return toward thumb direction
手腕转动时接管瞄准方向: Take over aim direction during wrist motion
摇杆决定粗略方向，手腕细调角度。推力保持不变，摇杆回到中心会清除角度偏移。: Use the stick for rough direction and the wrist for fine adjustment. Deflection magnitude stays unchanged; centering the stick clears the angle offset.
边缘处保留手腕控制: Retain wrist control at the edge
先用姿态归零键确定中立位。手腕超过边界后继续转向，向中心回拉可制动。: Set the neutral pose using Reset orientation. Turn beyond the boundary to keep turning; pull toward the center to brake.
在「体感行为」选择角速度瞄准后，可配置边缘转向。: Select Angular velocity aiming in Gyro behavior to configure edge turning.
关闭体感时也启用: Enable even when gyro is off
与体感共用输出 · 虚拟右摇杆: Shared with gyro · Virtual right stick
按住启用（不设置则常开）: Hold to enable (none means always enabled)
慢推锁定为连续瞄准: Lock slow pushes to continuous aiming
快推选择朝向，沿摇杆外圈转动控制镜头。先在「校准」测量游戏转角，才能对应准确的朝: Flick to select a heading, then rotate around the rim to turn the camera. Measure the in-game angle under Calibration for accurate headings.
抬高手柄前端: Raise the front of the controller
压低手柄前端: Lower the front of the controller
